listed_quote.quote: BlackRock Enhanced Government Fund, Inc. (NYSE: EGF) and BlackRock Income Trust, Inc. (NYSE: BKT)

announcement.quote: BlackRock Announces Board Approval of Closed-End Fund Reorganization

outcome_evidence.quote: BlackRock Enhanced Government Fund, Inc. (NYSE: EGF, the “Fund”) has completed its reorganization with and into BlackRock Income Trust, Inc. (NYSE: BKT and together with EGF, the “Funds,” and each, a “Fund”) (the “Reorganization”), effective as of the opening for business of the New York Stock Exchange on Monday, March 24, 2025.

deals.notes: Shareholder approval announced 2025-03-18 per a press-release title in the 425 of 2025-03-24. A Saba standstill agreement was filed 2025-01-21.
